parameters.command:
={
  cat "{{ $('Config').first().json.shared_rules_file }}"
  printf '\n\n'

  if [ -f "{{ $('Course Config').first().json.course_rules_file }}" ]; then
    cat "{{ $('Course Config').first().json.course_rules_file }}"
  else
    cat "{{ $('Course Config').first().json.fallback_rules_file }}"
  fi

  printf '\n\n'
  cat "{{ $('Config').first().json.discord_rules_file }}"
  printf '\n\n===== LECTURE + RETRIEVAL CONTEXT =====\n\n'
  cat "{{ $('Config').first().json.retrieval_context_file }}"
} | codex exec \
  --skip-git-repo-check \
  --model gpt-6-luna \
  --config 'model_reasoning_effort="high"' \
  --sandbox read-only \
  --output-last-message "{{ $('Config').first().json.generated_notes_file }}" \
  "The lecture number is {{ $('Config').first().json.lecture_number }}. Use the supplied lecture transcript as the source material and produce the notes according to all applicable rules above. The retrieval context contains transcript chunks paired with candidate textbook references. E5 rank is the initial embedding-retrieval rank and BGE rank is the reranker relevance rank; lower is better, but both are only retrieval signals. Judge each reference against the transcript and ignore any that are not relevant."
